frontmatter.title: Add Schema Qualifier Before Object References
frontmatter.description: Prefix every referenced object with its schema/owner (schema.object) to avoid ambiguity and wrong references in cross-schema or multi-tenant setups.

frontmatter.title: AddCheckConstraintShouldBeDeferred
frontmatter.description: Adding a CHECK to a populated table should use NO VALID to skip full-table validation; validate legacy rows offline in batches.

frontmatter.title: AddingColumnsWithDefaultDisallowed
frontmatter.description: Do not add columns with a DEFAULT to populated tables (rebuild/lock/backfill risk); add a nullable column, backfill, then set the DEFAULT in stages.

frontmatter.title: Auto-increment column naming convention
frontmatter.description: Auto-increment columns should follow one naming pattern (default `id`); inconsistent names raise a notice but do not block DDL.

frontmatter.title: Avoid ANTI JOIN Operations in Distributed Databases
frontmatter.description: Avoid NOT IN/NOT EXISTS anti-joins in distributed databases (full-data pull + huge memory/network); prefer materialization, split steps, or LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL.

frontmatter.title: Avoid COUNT DISTINCT on Multiple Nullable Columns
frontmatter.description: COUNT(DISTINCT col1, col2) drops rows where any column is NULL, unlike single-column COUNT(DISTINCT); use COALESCE defaults to get the expected counts.

frontmatter.title: Avoid CROSS JOIN
frontmatter.description: CROSS JOIN produces a Cartesian product and is almost always a performance trap; use an explicit join condition, or document the intent.

frontmatter.title: Avoid Cross-Shard DML Operations in Distributed Databases
frontmatter.description: DML whose WHERE does not pin the distribution key spans shards and needs slow, deadlock-prone distributed transactions; add a distribution-key equality.

frontmatter.title: Avoid Duplicate Table Aliases
frontmatter.description: Duplicate table aliases (or aliases colliding with real table names) destroy readability; every table reference needs a unique, meaningful alias.

frontmatter.title: Avoid FOR UPDATE with Derived Tables
frontmatter.description: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE over a derived table can lock the internal temporary table instead of the base rows; lock the base table directly.

frontmatter.title: Avoid GROUP BY Column Ordinal Position
frontmatter.description: GROUP BY 1,2 (column ordinals) silently changes meaning when the SELECT list changes; always name the columns or expressions.

frontmatter.title: Avoid GROUP BY on Long Columns
frontmatter.description: Grouping by over-long columns (CHAR/VARCHAR above 128 or CLOB/TEXT) is slow; group by a prefix or hash instead.

frontmatter.title: Avoid Joining on Non-Distribution Key Columns
frontmatter.description: Joining on a non-distribution key in a distributed database forces cross-node data redistribution and network cost; align high-frequency join keys with the distribution key.

frontmatter.title: Avoid Leading or Trailing Spaces in String Literals
frontmatter.description: Spaces at the start or end of string literals are usually typos but change matches; remove them, or use TRIM() when spaces are intended.

frontmatter.title: Avoid LIKE Without Wildcards
frontmatter.description: LIKE without wildcards equals an equality and usually signals a forgotten wildcard; use '=' or add the wildcards deliberately.

frontmatter.title: Avoid LIMIT Without ORDER BY in SELECT
frontmatter.description: SELECT ... LIMIT without ORDER BY returns nondeterministic rows; always add ORDER BY to define which rows are returned.

frontmatter.title: Avoid LIMIT Without ORDER BY in UPDATE/DELETE
frontmatter.description: UPDATE/DELETE ... LIMIT without ORDER BY touches nondeterministic rows; pair LIMIT with ORDER BY (or a WHERE subquery on PostgreSQL/openGauss).

frontmatter.title: Avoid Multiple Distribution Keys
frontmatter.description: Multiple-column distribution keys limit horizontal scaling, raise hashing cost, and block local joins unless every key matches; prefer a single, frequently-joined column.

frontmatter.title: Avoid NATURAL JOIN
frontmatter.description: NATURAL JOIN's implicit join conditions hurt readability and silently change when the schema changes; use explicit JOIN ... ON.

frontmatter.title: Avoid Non-Distributed Tables
frontmatter.description: Avoid local/non-distributed tables in distributed databases: they become single-node bottlenecks and force redistribution on joins; use HASH distribution.

frontmatter.title: Avoid ORDER BY Column Ordinal Position
frontmatter.description: ORDER BY 1,2 (column ordinals) silently changes meaning when the SELECT list changes; always name the columns or expressions.

frontmatter.title: Avoid ORDER BY on Long Columns
frontmatter.description: Sorting by over-long columns (CHAR/VARCHAR above 128 or CLOB/TEXT) is costly; sort by a prefix or hash instead.

frontmatter.title: Avoid ORDER BY Random Function
frontmatter.description: ORDER BY RAND()/RANDOM() sorts every row just to keep a few; sample via a random key range or TABLESAMPLE instead.

frontmatter.title: Avoid Replicated Distribution for Large Tables
frontmatter.description: Replicated distribution copies a table to every node; above the size threshold (default 100k rows) use HASH/sharded distribution instead.

frontmatter.title: Avoid Scalar Subqueries
frontmatter.description: Scalar subqueries run once per outer row and can fail at run time; prefer a JOIN or derived table.

frontmatter.title: Avoid SELECT with FOR UPDATE
frontmatter.description: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE adds row locks that cause waits, blocking, and deadlocks under concurrency; use it only when pessimistic locking is truly needed, on the fewest rows.

frontmatter.title: Avoid SELECT with LIMIT and FOR UPDATE
frontmatter.description: ORDER BY + LIMIT + FOR UPDATE locks far more rows than it returns; fetch the primary keys first, then lock them precisely.

frontmatter.title: CacheExhausted4IdentityColumn
frontmatter.description: Warn when an auto-increment/identity column nears its type maximum (default 80%); plan capacity (e.g. INT to BIGINT) before inserts fail.

frontmatter.title: ChangingColumnNameDisallowed
frontmatter.description: Do not rename a column directly (breaks every dependent app/report/ETL/view); when required use a staged rollout: new column, dual-write, switch, drop old.

frontmatter.title: ChangingColumn's Order Disallowed
frontmatter.description: Reordering table columns triggers a rebuild and can break position-dependent code; fix order at design time and migrate via a new table if needed.

frontmatter.title: ChangingColumnTypeDisallowed
frontmatter.description: Do not change a column type in place (full rewrite/lock/truncation risk); use a staged migration: new column, dual-write, batched backfill, switch, drop old.

frontmatter.title: Char Column Length Exceeds Threshold
frontmatter.description: Flag CHAR columns longer than the configurable threshold (default 64); oversized fixed-width CHAR bloat rows, indexes, and I/O. Recommend VARCHAR instead.

frontmatter.title: Character Set Required for Database Creation
frontmatter.description: CREATE DATABASE must set the character set explicitly so defaults do not vary by environment and cause mojibake across deployments.

frontmatter.title: CharsetOnColumnDisallowed
frontmatter.description: Per-column character sets cause implicit conversion on JOIN (index invalidation, full scans) and comparison bugs; set the charset uniformly at table level.

frontmatter.title: CharsetOnTableDisallowed
frontmatter.description: Do not override the character set at table level; tables should inherit the database default to avoid cross-table implicit conversion.

frontmatter.title: CharsetsOnTable&DatabaseMismatch
frontmatter.description: Table and database character sets must match to avoid implicit conversion, mojibake, or data loss; tables should inherit the database default charset.

frontmatter.title: Column and Table Character Set Mismatch
frontmatter.description: Column and table character sets must match to avoid conversion, truncation, mojibake, and JOIN index invalidation; columns should inherit the table charset.

frontmatter.title: Column Naming Convention
frontmatter.description: Column names should be lowercase snake_case; uppercase, special, keyword, or Chinese names hurt readability and cross-platform migration.

frontmatter.title: Column with this Name Already Exists
frontmatter.description: Adding or renaming a column to a name that already exists fails the DDL; guard with IF NOT EXISTS or confirm the name is unique first.

frontmatter.title: Comments on Column Required
frontmatter.description: Every column needs a COMMENT so its meaning, purpose, and value domain stay clear to developers and DBAs across changes and handover.

frontmatter.title: CommentsOnTableRequired
frontmatter.description: CREATE TABLE should carry a table COMMENT (business purpose, data source, lifecycle); applies to engines supporting table comments such as MySQL.

frontmatter.title: CompressedAttributeDisallowed
frontmatter.description: Do not enable column-level COMPRESSED (mojibake risk on utf8/utf8mb4, extra CPU); compress at the storage/engine or application layer instead.

frontmatter.title: Consider Replicated Distribution for Small Tables
frontmatter.description: Small distributed tables (below ~100k rows, read-heavy) are often better as replicated tables so joins avoid cross-node data exchange.

frontmatter.title: Constraint with this Name Already Exists
frontmatter.description: Constraint names must be unique per database/table; a duplicate name fails the SQL and can break deployment or migration scripts.

frontmatter.title: Create Index Before Constraint
frontmatter.description: Create the backing index before adding a constraint (unique/FK/CHECK) so validation reuses it instead of full-table scanning under lock.

frontmatter.title: Create Index Using Online Mode
frontmatter.description: Create indexes online (MySQL ALGORITHM=INPLACE LOCK=NONE, PostgreSQL CONCURRENTLY) to avoid long locks and DML blocking on large tables.

frontmatter.title: UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE
frontmatter.description: UPDATE/DELETE without a WHERE clause affects the whole table and is a common data-loss source; add a predicate, or use TRUNCATE deliberately to clear it.

frontmatter.title: Expression in GROUP BY Causes Index Invalidation
frontmatter.description: GROUP BY on an expression or function (LEFT, YEAR) disables the column index and forces an extra sort or hash aggregate; group by the bare column.

frontmatter.title: Expression in ORDER BY Causes Index Invalidation
frontmatter.description: ORDER BY on an expression or function (YEAR, LENGTH) makes the underlying column index unusable for sorting and adds a filesort; order by the bare column.

frontmatter.title: INSERT Must Include Primary Key Column
frontmatter.description: On tables without an auto-increment primary key, INSERT must supply the key explicitly to avoid duplicate or unexpected key values and data inconsistency.

frontmatter.title: ORDER BY Forbidden in UPDATE/DELETE
frontmatter.description: ORDER BY is meaningless in UPDATE/DELETE, adds cost, and is a syntax error in some databases; remove it or move the ordered selection into a subquery.

frontmatter.title: Primary Key Naming Convention
frontmatter.description: Primary-key constraints should follow one naming convention (e.g. pk_<table>_<columns>) so the constraint type and table are recognizable at a glance.

frontmatter.title: SELECT * Detection
frontmatter.description: Flags SELECT * on wide tables: unneeded columns cost IO and bandwidth and block covering-index optimization; list only the columns you need.

frontmatter.title: Audit Rule Reference
frontmatter.description: Catalog of PawSQL SQL audit rules (generated)

frontmatter.title: Redundant Index Detection
frontmatter.description: Detects duplicate or redundant indexes whose leading columns another index already covers; they only add write and storage cost, so drop them.

frontmatter.title: explain.timeout
frontmatter.description: Time budget the optimizer uses when executing EXPLAIN to gather real execution statistics before recommending an index.

frontmatter.title: Optimizer Rule Reference
frontmatter.description: Catalog of PawSQL optimizer rules (generated)

frontmatter.title: COUNT Scalar Subquery Rewrite
frontmatter.description: Rewrites (SELECT COUNT(*) ...) > 0 presence tests into EXISTS, which short-circuits on the first match instead of aggregating every row.

frontmatter.title: EXISTS Subquery to Table Join Rewrite
frontmatter.description: Rewrites convertible EXISTS subqueries into an equivalent inner join so the optimizer can choose the driving table freely.

frontmatter.title: NPE Rewrite (Null Pointer Exception Prevention)
frontmatter.description: Wraps aggregates that can return NULL on all-NULL input (e.g. SUM) in a null-handling function so the result is always numeric and apps avoid NPE.

frontmatter.title: OR to UNION Optimization
frontmatter.description: Rewrites OR-ed predicates over different columns into UNION / UNION ALL branches so each branch can use its own index instead of one fused plan.

frontmatter.title: Use UNION ALL Instead of UNION
frontmatter.description: Replaces UNION with UNION ALL when no deduplication is needed, skipping the sort/hash pass for a large speedup on big result sets.

frontmatter.title: 产品概览
frontmatter.description: PawSQL 让 SQL 性能优化自动化、可验证：规范审核、语义级查询重写与基于代价的索引推荐。

frontmatter.title: 支持的数据库
frontmatter.description: PawSQL 支持优化的数据库与版本范围。

frontmatter.title: PawSQL 文档
frontmatter.description: PawSQL 让数据库性能优化自动化且可验证：SQL 审核、语义级查询重写、基于代价的索引推荐。

frontmatter.title: 对象前需添加属主
frontmatter.description: SQL 引用对象前加 Schema/属主限定（schema.object），避免跨 Schema/多租户下同名对象歧义与误引用。

frontmatter.title: 添加CHECK约束时需添加NO VALID
frontmatter.description: 给已有数据的表加 CHECK 约束时应指定 NO VALID 跳过全表校验，历史数据分批离线验证。

frontmatter.title: 禁止新增有默认值的列
frontmatter.description: 禁止向已有数据的表直接新增带默认值的列（触发表重写/锁表/回填）；应分阶段：加可空列→回填→再设默认值。

frontmatter.title: 自增列命名规范
frontmatter.description: 自增列命名应遵循统一模式（默认 `id`，正则 `^id$`）；不合规仅提示，不阻断 DDL。

frontmatter.title: 分布式数据库应避免出现 ANTI JOIN 操作
frontmatter.description: 分布式库应避免 NOT IN/NOT EXISTS 反连接（拉取全量到协调端、内存/网络开销巨大）；用物化/拆分或 LEFT JOIN+IS NULL。

frontmatter.title: 避免COUNT DISTINCT多个可空列
frontmatter.description: COUNT(DISTINCT 多列) 会排除任一列为 NULL 的行，结果与单列去重不同；用 COALESCE 换默认值再计数。

frontmatter.title: 避免使用CROSS JOIN
frontmatter.description: 避免 CROSS JOIN 产生的笛卡尔积（性能陷阱）；应改用带 ON 条件的关联，确需笛卡尔积时加注释说明。

frontmatter.title: 分布式数据库应避免跨分片的 DML 操作
frontmatter.description: UPDATE/DELETE 的 WHERE 未含分布键等值会跨分片触发分布式事务（慢且易死锁）；应加分布键等值条件。

frontmatter.title: 避免表引用使用重复的别名
frontmatter.description: 避免表引用别名重复或与库表名冲突（可读性差）；每个表引用用唯一且有语义的别名。

frontmatter.title: 避免有派生表的查询语句使用for update
frontmatter.description: 派生表上的 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE 锁可能落在内部临时表而非基表；应直接对基表加锁。

frontmatter.title: 避免GROUP BY选择列的序号
frontmatter.description: 避免 GROUP BY 用列序号（SELECT 顺序变化会悄然改变语义）；直接用列名或表达式。

frontmatter.title: 避免对长字段进行分组
frontmatter.description: 避免对超长字段分组（CHAR/VARCHAR>128 或 CLOB/TEXT，排序/哈希开销大）；用前缀或哈希分组。

frontmatter.title: 避免表关联字段不是分布键
frontmatter.description: 分布式库中 JOIN 关联字段非分布键会触发跨节点数据重分布、网络开销大；应让高频关联字段与分布键对齐。

frontmatter.title: 避免常量字符串开头或结尾包含空格
frontmatter.description: 字符串常量首尾空格多为误输入却影响匹配结果；应清理，确需匹配空格时用 TRIM 或注释说明。

frontmatter.title: 避免使用没有通配符的 LIKE 查询
frontmatter.description: 无通配符的 LIKE 等价于等值查询，多为漏写通配符；应改 = 或明确补 %/_。

frontmatter.title: 避免在SELECT语句中使用LIMIT而没有ORDER BY
frontmatter.description: SELECT 用 LIMIT 无 ORDER BY 时返回行不确定；加 ORDER BY 明确取哪前 N 行。

frontmatter.title: 避免在UPDELETE语句中使用LIMIT而没有ORDER
frontmatter.description: UPDATE/DELETE 用 LIMIT 无 ORDER BY 影响行不确定；应配 ORDER BY（PG/openGauss 用 WHERE 子查询定位）。

frontmatter.title: 分布键不建议使用多个字段
frontmatter.description: 多列分布键限制水平扩展、增加哈希与本地化关联难度；建议用单一高频关联字段作分布键。

frontmatter.title: 避免使用NATURAL JOIN
frontmatter.description: 避免 NATURAL JOIN（隐式连接条件可读性差、表结构变化会悄然改变语义）；用显式 JOIN ... ON。

frontmatter.title: 分布式数据库不建议创建非分布表
frontmatter.description: 分布式数据库应避免非分布表（单点瓶颈、关联需重分布）；业务表用 HASH 分布。

frontmatter.title: 避免ORDER BY选择列的序号
frontmatter.description: 避免 ORDER BY 用列序号（SELECT 顺序变化会悄然改变语义）；直接用列名或表达式。

frontmatter.title: 避免对长字段进行排序
frontmatter.description: 避免对超长字段直接排序（比较代价与临时空间大）；用前缀（LEFT）或哈希排序替代。

frontmatter.title: 避免使用随机函数排序
frontmatter.description: 避免 ORDER BY RAND()/RANDOM() 取随机样本（需对全行生成随机值并排序）；用随机主键范围或 TABLESAMPLE。

frontmatter.title: 大表不建议使用复制(Replicated)分布
frontmatter.description: 大表（默认超 10 万行）不宜用复制分布（存储与写放大）；应改用 HASH 等分片分布。

frontmatter.title: 避免使用标量子查询
frontmatter.description: 避免标量子查询（外层每行执行一次、大表性能差、可能运行时多行报错）；用 JOIN/派生表替代。

frontmatter.title: 避免在SELECT语句添加FOR UPDATE
frontmatter.description: 避免随意 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE（行锁致等待/阻塞/死锁）；仅确需悲观锁时使用，并尽量缩小锁定范围。

frontmatter.title: 避免limit子句的查询语句使用for update
frontmatter.description: 避免 ORDER BY+LIMIT+FOR UPDATE（锁定行数远超返回、竞争严重）；分两步：先取主键再精确加锁。

frontmatter.title: 自增序列耗尽预警
frontmatter.description: 自增列接近类型最大值（默认阈值 80%）时预警，提前规划扩容（如 INT→BIGINT），避免 INSERT 失败。

frontmatter.title: 禁止修改字段名
frontmatter.description: 禁止直接改字段名（破坏上下游依赖）；需要时用灰度：加新列→双写→切换→下线旧列。

frontmatter.title: 禁止修改列的顺序
frontmatter.description: 禁止调整表内列顺序（触发表重建、破坏按位置依赖）；顺序在设计时定，需要则新建表迁移。

frontmatter.title: 禁止修改列的数据类型
frontmatter.description: 禁止直接改列类型（全表重写/锁表/截断风险）；用灰度迁移：新列→双写→分批回填→切换→下线。

frontmatter.title: CHAR 字段长度超过阈值
frontmatter.description: 检查声明长度超过阈值（默认 64）的 CHAR 字段：定长存储会让过大的 CHAR 膨胀行与索引、增加 I/O，建议改用 VARCHAR。

frontmatter.title: 创建库必须指定数据库字符集
frontmatter.description: 创建库必须显式指定字符集，避免默认配置随环境变化导致乱码与排序不一致。

frontmatter.title: 禁止指定列的字符集
frontmatter.description: 禁止列级单独指定字符集（JOIN 隐式转换致索引失效/全表扫描）；字符集在表级统一。

frontmatter.title: 表定义时禁止使用字符集
frontmatter.description: 表定义时禁止单独指定字符集；表应继承数据库默认字符集，避免跨表隐式转换。

frontmatter.title: 表的字符集和数据库不一致
frontmatter.description: 表字符集须与数据库一致，避免隐式转换、乱码或数据丢失；让表继承数据库默认字符集。

frontmatter.title: 列的字符集和表不一致
frontmatter.description: 列字符集应与表一致，避免隐式转换/乱码/JOIN 索引失效；列继承表字符集。

frontmatter.title: 列名命名规范
frontmatter.description: 列名应统一小写下划线 snake_case；大写/特殊字符/关键字/中文命名增加维护与迁移成本。

frontmatter.title: 字段名已存在
frontmatter.description: ADD/RENAME COLUMN 的列名不能与表内已有列冲突；可用 IF NOT EXISTS 或先确认唯一。

frontmatter.title: 列必须有注释
frontmatter.description: 每列都应有注释（字段含义/用途/取值范围），降低变更、排查与交接成本。

frontmatter.title: 表必须有注释
frontmatter.description: 建表时应写表注释（业务用途/数据来源/生命周期），适用于 MySQL 等支持表注释的库。

frontmatter.title: 禁止通过COMPRESSED打开字段压缩功能
frontmatter.description: 禁止用 COMPRESSED 做列级压缩（utf8/utf8mb4 易乱码、增 CPU 开销）；压缩放到存储/引擎层。

frontmatter.title: 小于阈值的分布表建议设计为复制表
frontmatter.description: 分布式小表（10 万行以下、读多写少）建议设计为复制表，关联避免跨节点数据交换。

frontmatter.title: 约束名已存在
frontmatter.description: 约束名须唯一，重名会使 DDL 失败并中断部署/迁移；可用 IF NOT EXISTS 或唯一命名。

frontmatter.title: 创建约束前提前创建相关的索引
frontmatter.description: 加唯一/外键/CHECK 约束前先建对应索引，约束校验可复用索引、避免全表扫描。

frontmatter.title: 建议使用在线模式创建索引
frontmatter.description: 建索引优先在线模式（MySQL INPLACE/LOCK=NONE、PostgreSQL CONCURRENTLY），避免大表长锁阻塞 DML。

frontmatter.title: 避免无条件的 UPDATE/DELETE 语句
frontmatter.description: 无条件（无 WHERE）的 UPDATE/DELETE 会作用于整张表，是数据丢失的常见根源；应加条件，确需清空时用 TRUNCATE。

frontmatter.title: GROUP 字段中有表达式导致索引失效
frontmatter.description: GROUP BY 使用表达式或函数（如 LEFT、YEAR）会令列索引失效，退化为额外排序或哈希分组；应直接按列分组。

frontmatter.title: ORDER 字段中有表达式导致索引失效
frontmatter.description: ORDER BY 使用表达式或函数（如 YEAR、LENGTH）会使列索引无法用于排序、退化为文件排序；应直接按列排序。

frontmatter.title: INSERT 语句必须包含主键字段
frontmatter.description: 对无自增主键的表，INSERT 必须显式包含主键列并提供明确的值，避免主键冲突与数据不一致。

frontmatter.title: UPDATE/DELETE 禁止使用 ORDER 子句
frontmatter.description: UPDATE/DELETE 中 ORDER BY 无意义且增加开销，某些数据库甚至是语法错误；应移除或将排序放进子查询。

frontmatter.title: 主键命名规范
frontmatter.description: 主键约束命名应遵循统一规范（如 pk_表名_列名），便于快速识别约束类型与归属表，降低协作与排查成本。

frontmatter.title: 避免在查询中使用 SELECT *
frontmatter.description: 识别查询中的 SELECT *：无用列浪费 IO 与带宽，且阻碍覆盖索引优化；应只列出所需列。

frontmatter.title: 审核规范
frontmatter.description: PawSQL SQL 审核规则全量目录（由 metadata/rules/audit 生成）

frontmatter.title: 禁止创建重复索引/冗余索引
frontmatter.description: 检测重复/冗余索引：其前缀列已被其它索引覆盖，只会增加写入与存储成本，应删除。

frontmatter.title: 优化算法
frontmatter.description: PawSQL 优化器规则/算法全量目录（由 metadata/rules/optimizer 生成）

frontmatter.title: COUNT 标量子查询重写
frontmatter.description: 将 (SELECT COUNT(*) ...)>0 的存在性判断重写为 EXISTS，命中首行即短路，避免全量计数。

frontmatter.title: EXISTS 查询转换为表连接
frontmatter.description: 将可转换的 EXISTS 子查询重写为等价内连接，让优化器可自由选择驱动表。

frontmatter.title: NPE 重写（空指针异常预防）
frontmatter.description: 当聚合输入全为 NULL 时 SUM/AVG 返回 NULL 可能引发程序 NPE；自动用空值处理函数包装聚合，保证返回数值。

frontmatter.title: OR 条件 SELECT 重写
frontmatter.description: 将连接不同字段的 OR 条件重写为 UNION（分支互斥用 UNION ALL），让各分支独立利用索引，避免单一计划退化为全表扫描。

frontmatter.title: 使用 UNION ALL 代替 UNION
frontmatter.description: 当无需去重时用 UNION ALL 替代 UNION，省去排序/哈希去重过程，大数据量下性能提升显著。

frontmatter.description: 不同角色的 PawSQL 典型使用场景（开发者 / CI/CD / DBA / 迁移 / 企业治理）。

frontmatter.description: PawSQL Cloud 产品概述：能力范围、核心功能与支持的数据库。
